The prior lesson: `shell_environment_policy.set.OBSIDIAN_VAULT_DIRECTORY` supplies child tool environments, but native `SessionStart` and `SessionEnd` callbacks need that variable in the **parent host worker’s environment**. A shell check succeeded while callbacks reported `vault_matches=false`; setting the host worker environment made both callbacks report `true` and delivered the note plus both indexes.

Regression marker **`quasar-journal-731`**: independently verify both native callbacks and delivery of the note and both indexes to the intended vault. Keep the tool-environment-only configuration as a negative control.
